scope: The previous 500ms snapshots are reproduced at their recorded iteration counts; no new time comparison is made. Extract the most-visited pure action at each learned own history, resolving ties by final action index. Only the first two decisions are constrained. At an unvisited history and after the second decision the policy is given optimal play, so these are optimistic upper bounds, not lower guarantees or complete policy values. The adversary uses the same fixed Sleep Talk, Sleep Talk, Hidden Power Ice schedule used in the archived certificates; it does not observe the current simultaneous draw. All root chance traces are enumerated without state/log merging and their exact rational masses reproduce all 39 archived root kernels. The existing deeper counterpolicy ledgers supply the bounds. This diagnoses frozen continuation extraction, not a bot that replans with a fresh 500ms after every observation. The 39-world model, fixed stats/items/sleep clock and full engine history restrictions remain.
